description: This PHP class defines the SchedulerMigrationResult, which encapsulates the outcome of a scheduler migration process, including success status, messages, and details.

classes.name: SchedulerMigrationResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a scheduler migration operation, including success status, messages, and detailed info.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Creates a successful skip result with an optional message.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Creates a successful migration result, indicating number of schedulers found and updated, with optional dry run flag.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Creates an error result, optionally including exception details.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Checks if the migration was successful.

methods.name: hasSchedulers
methods.description: Checks if any schedulers were found.

methods.name: isDryRun
methods.description: Checks if the operation was a dry run.

methods.name: wasSkipped
methods.description: Checks if the migration was skipped.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the migration result, including status, messages, and details.
